description: You can follow a unique_ptr move and automatic cleanup of two resource kinds.

steps.description: Widget prints messages from construction, drawing, and destruction. Its name identifies the managed object.
FileCloser closes a non-null FILE pointer. The demonstration first creates a Widget through make_unique and calls draw.

steps.answer: w2 owns it, and w1 is null.
steps.question: After the move, which pointer owns the Widget?

steps.description: The null check confirms w1's moved state. A separate unique_ptr uses FileCloser for the file resource.
Leaving the scope invokes resource cleanup. The supplied output shows File closed before Widget(Button) destroyed.

title: Transfer exclusive ownership
